label: Excellent
reviews: I discovered Brik from my interest in the ongoing redevelopment of Stockport, and could soon see they were a group of individuals with great passion and purpose. Charlie has been my main point of call throughout and is consistently fantastic to deal with. I first met Charlie when he gave me a tour of Stockport's historical centre, and his knowledge of the area and the regeneration underway is excellent. It was incredibly refreshing to meet someone with so much enthusiasm and genuine care for the history and future of Stockport. I made the decision to invest in one of Brik’s new builds, and I’m really excited to be a part of their journey. With all the legal and financial side of the transaction, I have dealt with Jawaad, who has also been equally excellent to deal with. Brik are a fantastic team of professional, very pleasant and friendly people who I can highly recommend to anyone interested in investing in property and don’t have time to do the extensive research themselves. Thank you and best of luck to you Brik!

Really great experience with Brik Studios. The whole process was professional, easy and completely stress-free from start to finish. Charlie was fantastic, very charming, helpful and always on the ball with everything. Communication was excellent and nothing ever felt like too much trouble. He made the whole process feel straightforward and well looked after. Would definitely recommend Brik to anyone looking for a professional, friendly and reliable service.

I’ve been speaking to Jawaad about investing for a few weeks now and have recently committed to a beautiful apartment in Stockport. As someone fairly new to this type of investment, Jawaad has been incredibly helpful throughout the whole process. He’s taken the time to explain everything properly, answer all of my questions, and make sure I actually understand what I’m investing in. He’s been really approachable, knowledgeable, and transparent, which has made me feel comfortable and much more educated about the process. So far, I’ve had a really positive experience with Jawaad and Brik Studios and I’m excited to see how the investment progresses.

James has so much knowledge of what’s going on in Stockport right now, I would really recommend working with the BRIK team if you’re looking to invest in the area. They were always there to answer my questions and made the process really smooth.
A dynamic, modern day property agency with traditional values at their very core

As someone whose family has long-standing roots in Stockport, I was genuinely impressed by the depth of local insight Charlie and the team brought. Not only about the revitalisation of the town centre (which was long overdue) but how these redevelopments will shape the area for years to come. After finally deciding to take the step of purchasing my first property, the team at Brik team were exceptional from start to finish. Where other agencies seem to overlook the value of clear, consistent communication, Brik made it a clear it was a non-negotiable. They delivered a level of care and professionalism that made me feel truly valued as a client.
We’ve had a fantastic experience with Brik Studios

We’ve had a fantastic experience with Brik Studios and couldn’t recommend them highly enough! As first-time investors into the rental market, the whole process has been very new to us (my wife and I), but Charlie and Jawaad have been brilliant, they’ve guided us through every step of the way so far with clear advice, patience, and support, making what could have been a daunting process feel much more straightforward. Their assistance has been invaluable. If you’re looking to invest in property in Stockport, we would absolutely recommend Brik Studios!

I purchased a property through BRIK in one of their Stockport developments and having dealt with other brokers in the past, I can honestly say the whole experience from start to finish was a pleasurable and professional one. That’s not always the case with brokers and agents. I felt looked after throughout, and all the information I needed was handed over and clearly explained, which made the whole process, including the off-plan side of things, feel far less daunting than it could have been. Communication was consistent and I never felt left in the dark on where things stood. Would happily recommend them to anyone considering a similar purchase.

Charlie was extremely knowledgeable about the apartments in Stockport and demonstrated a clear understanding of the differing business models between buy-to-let investment and residential purchasing, which was a refreshing and welcome surprise. Our conversation around the various investment options was both insightful and genuinely enjoyable. Charlie took the time to explain things clearly, answered my questions with confidence, and brought a level of professionalism and depth of knowledge that I have rarely experienced within this sector. It was particularly reassuring to speak with someone who not only understood the market locally but could also appreciate the wider financial and strategic considerations involved in property investment. Overall, it was a very positive experience, and one that stood out for all the right reasons.

Brik were responsive and supportive both before and after we completed the apartment purchase. We were inspired by their ethos, values and passion for the communities they are building in. Can’t wait to watch the build progress and Brik are keeping us updated at each stage.

Charlie took time out of a busy schedule to show me several properties and developments in Stockport Town Centre. The company is clearly very passionate about developing the area in a way that respects its conservation status. It was evident that significant time and effort had been invested in developing the investment research presentation materials.
Exceptional Service and a Seamless Investment Experience

I had an amazing experience investing with Brik Studios. From start to finish, the whole team were brilliant — friendly, professional, and genuinely committed to helping me make the right investment in Manchester. Charlie was fantastic to deal with and went above and beyond to answer every question and keep me updated throughout the process. What stood out most was how seamless and transparent everything felt — there was never any pressure, just honest advice and clear communication from everyone involved. I’m really happy with my investment and the support I’ve received from the Brik Studios team. I’d highly recommend them to anyone looking to invest in Manchester property.

The After Sales service by Jawaad has been nothing short of exceptional. I cannot praise him enough for the professionalism, dedication, and genuine care shown throughout my property journey. From the very first interaction, I felt completely supported. Every detail was handled with efficiency and precision, and no question was ever too small or inconvenient. The communication was proactive, clear, and always reassuring. What truly impressed me was the level of personal attention and commitment. It’s rare to find someone who not only ensures the process runs smoothly but also goes above and beyond to make sure you feel confident and looked after every step of the way. This experience has far exceeded my expectations, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Jawaad to anyone considering property sourcing in Manchester. The after-sales support is second to none and makes all the difference. A truly five-star service (I would give it six if that was available).
